selectors.selector: the stale copy makes Pester refuse a module-scoped mock (the failure being prevented)
selectors.needs: Pester 5, TestDrive and synthetic modules; Windows and Linux.
selectors.detects: Pester or PowerShell no longer refusing duplicate module names, which would make every isolation test vacuous.
selectors.reviewScope: Pending independent review. The reviewer is not the claude family. Reviewer questions: does the selector still protect behavior that ships (relevance), does it fail when the helper is broken (coverage; the first selector is the positive control that two loaded copies make Pester refuse a module-scoped mock), and what does a change to it permit that was refused before (breaking behavior).
